## Poster submission

**Please check every item below before creating the pull request.**
To tick a box, change `[ ]` into `[x]`.

### Poster
- [ ] My poster is exactly **80x120px**.
- [ ] It is a **PNG** or **GIF**.
- [ ] I drew it myself, it's an original work, not AI-made.

### Files
- [ ] The poster is in the `posters` folder and named like `film-title-username.png` or `.gif` (lowercase, hyphens, no spaces).
- [ ] I added my `<figure>` block right below the "Paste your poster" comment in `index.html`, above the other posters.
- [ ] The `src` in my block matches my file name exactly.
- [ ] Film title, year and username are correct.
- [ ] I did not change anything else in `index.html`.

### Website
- [ ] The link on my username goes to **my own website** and it works.

### Before you submit
- [ ] I made my changes on a **separate branch** (like `add-film-title`), not on `main`.
- [ ] Below this text box, **"Allow edits by maintainers" is checked**, so the maintainer can fix small issues or conflicts for me.
